name: The CodFather
detailed_description:
"That wasn't fish. It was a real 3D hack and slash from a madman with a Cod!"

Welcome to the world of cod.

This game is a 3D wave action game where you fight using Cod as a weapon.

In Classic Mode, you can acquire card skills by eating the gems that drop when you kill enemies, and in Challenge Mode, you can automatically acquire card skills every 40 seconds.

Level up your skills and survive longer! Good luck!

[ ▣ Game Concept ▣ ]

The game started with a very simple idea.

The term 'ecological' originated from the fact that it was called by various names depending on the condition or drying method of the Cod.

I found it interesting how Cod changes depending on its environment, and the idea came to me that it would be fun to give it different attributes and make it into a skill.

In this way, a battle system that humorously interprets the characteristics of pollack was born, and the 3D action wave method was chosen as the genre that could best express it.

[ ▣ Card System ▣ ]

In the game, players can have up to five skills, and the skills vary depending on the turn they appear.

Only active skills appear in the first 1-2 turns, and only passive skills appear in turns 3-5.

From the 6th turn onwards, active, passive, and basic skills will appear mixed together.

If you select a skill that you already have from the skills that appear this way, the level of that skill will increase. If you have all 5 skills, no new skills will appear and you will only be able to select to level up existing skills.

Skills have different maximum levels depending on their type, and have different limits depending on the game mode.

In Classic Mode, the maximum level of all skills is limited to 3. In Challenge Mode, the maximum level of active and passive skills, excluding basic skills, is expanded to 5.

Basic skills are skills that are closely related to a character's basic stats.

As the game progresses, various combinations and strategies become possible, and strategic choices depending on the turn become an important factor.

[ ▣ Customizing ▣ ]

You can customize your character with various costume items obtained through battle, allowing you to enjoy the battlefield in your own style.

★ Only Korean and English are supported in the game. ★

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11
  • Processor: Intel(R) Core i5-4460 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 750 Ti / RX 560 Over
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
